evidence.quote: - FARXIGA is not recommended for use to improve glycemic control in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus with an eGFR less than 45 mL/min/1.73 m^2. FARXIGA is likely to be ineffective in this setting based upon its mechanism of action.
